name: open_document
description: Open a .docx file into a session (Map sessionId->DocHandle, LRU 10 docs / 200MB / 30min idle evict). Returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,summary,evicted} where evicted:string[] lists sessions dropped by the capacity cap to make room (re-open them if needed; later calls with an evicted id fail with E_SESSION plus a close_document remedy). The default summary is compact: palette, counts, header/footer text, chart ids and pending-revision flag. Pass {"summaryOnly":false} for the full structural summary including styles XML. Example input {"path":"documents/report.docx"} -> {"ok":true,"sessionId":"sess_abc","revision":1,"evicted":[]}. Open first; keep the sessionId for every later call. The response also carries validation: {status:"valid"}, {status:"invalid",preExistingErrors,messages,baselineComparable,note} when the file already has validator errors (edits that add no new error can still be saved), {status:"timed-out"} or {status:"skipped"}. The check waits validationTimeoutMs (default 5000 ms; 0 skips it; server flag --open-validation-timeout, env ASTRA_OPEN_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT_MS) and never refuses the open. Macro/active content refuses by default (E_VALIDATION naming the parts): pass {"allowMacros":true} to preserve or {"stripMacros":true} to strip (never both). Session ids are server-minted (sess_<uuid>, DEPRECATED to supply sessionId: client-supplied values are rejected with E_VALIDATION; deterministic ids are test-only via --allow-client-session-ids). IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions, and duplicate client-supplied ids are rejected. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.

sessionId.description: DEPRECATED: session ids are server-minted (sess_<uuid>); omit sessionId and use the returned id. Client-supplied values are rejected with E_VALIDATION (deterministic ids are test-only via --allow-client-session-ids).
